data.narrative:
Askari Defense operates in the Defense & Security sector at an undisclosed stage. The comparable universe consists of 2 public peers (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private competitors, including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Saronic, and Quantum-Systems. This narrow universe reflects the specialized nature of frontier defense technology.

The Peer-Median triangulation method is not applicable here. While 23 same-sector peers exist in Defense & Security overall, filtering for stage-aligned, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier comparables yielded fewer than three datapoints in any single cohort. Applying an all-sector median would introduce unacceptable noise given Askari's specialized positioning and would not reflect true comparable trading or funding multiples. The methodological constraint—requiring a minimum of three comparable observations per method—prevents reliable peer-based valuation synthesis at this time.

Without sufficient narrow-stage peer data and in the absence of other applicable triangulation methods in the dataset, a defensible valuation range cannot be derived from the information provided. Material uncertainties remain around Askari's current fundraising stage, revenue profile, and technical differentiation relative to the identified peer set. Further diligence would require either: stage clarification and deployment of revenue or margin multiples against the 10-company peer pool, or disclosure of historical funding round data enabling venture-stage benchmarking.
